correctness.rationale: Each rate in the eight-state generator is specified. The unique stationary distribution exists for every c>0 because of irreducibility. Symbolic rational inversion independently verified by generator balance produces exact formulas for empty and fully occupied probabilities for both source choices. Their differences factor as c^2 S/(D_E D_C) and c T/(D_E D_C) with positive denominators. S has exactly one sign change, a negative constant term and positive leading coefficient: Descartes and continuity establish a unique positive zero. T has all-positive coefficients, establishing universal strict center dominance for regional occupancy. The attached script reconstructs the algebra and compares 112 cofactor-based exact stationary weights; finite checks are ancillary.
correctness.scientific_limits: At c=0 the chain is reducible and the theorem deliberately excludes it. Only rates fixed to one and the three-site chain are covered. The exact sign proof is not based on numerical root-finding.

originality.rationale: Actual semantic index and targeted literature searches found no exact three-site, fixed-unit-rate, one-immigration-gateway theorem comparing simultaneous occupation and regional persistence. Foxall establishes the encompassing process and monotonicity only for comparable parameter vectors; moving the sole positive immigration rate between nodes is not a coordinatewise comparison. Economou and collaborators give general computations, which do not supply the exact threshold and sign classification as stated in inspected material. Published general equations permit the independent calculation but do not logically yield the sign pattern without a separate exact comparison. Priority remains provisional, with documented full-text and historical risks.
residual_risks: A specialized earlier finite-SIS enumeration or unpublished dissertation may already tabulate this sign change.
The complete Economou et al. accepted manuscript was not fully accessible during inspection; its generic finite-network algorithm makes it a plausible source for future full-text cross-check.
Older mainland–island papers were not comprehensively full-text searched; their abstracts do not prove absence.
Search-result similarity and absence are not proofs of priority; independent historical and mathematical validation remains outstanding.

value.rationale: The three-vertex path is the smallest connected graph with genuinely nonisomorphic single-immigration sites. The exact unique reversal in full-occupancy optimization versus the unconditional center superiority for regional persistence reveals an objective-dependent structural tradeoff, not a routine positivity computation or arbitrary parameter slice. The model matches a recognizable source–sink/recolonization mechanism and supplies a minimal benchmark without asserting field validity.
value.scope_limit: The claim is a mathematically sharp idealized stationary benchmark, not a generalized large-network law or a policy recommendation.
